meta.name: create-image-gpt-image-fal
meta.description: Generate a single photoreal or designed image with OpenAI gpt-image via fal.ai. Supports gpt-image-1 (default, fixed sizes — the FAL fallback for Higgsfield's `gpt_image_2`) and gpt-image-2 (`openai/gpt-image-2`, custom output sizes up to 3840px). Routes to text-to-image or the edit variant depending on whether a reference image is provided. Use for photoreal character anchors, scene keyframes, and designed sheets (e.g. storyboards) where precise layout and legible text matter.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用AI生成照片级或设计感图像
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成高质量图像用于视觉叙事或设计稿。
copy.tagline_en: Generate photoreal or designed images with AI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate high-quality images for visual storytelling or design drafts.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能通过 fal.ai 调用 OpenAI 的 gpt-image-1 或 gpt-image-2 模型生成一张照片级或设计图。支持文字生图，也支持传入参考图进行编辑。
howto.when: 当你要求生成角色锚点、场景关键帧或故事板等需要精确布局和清晰文字的设计图时触发。

say.text: 生成一张 9:16 的角色锚点图，提示词：一个穿蓝衬衫的年轻女性。
say.note: 使用默认模型 gpt-image-1 生成角色肖像。

say.text: 基于这张参考图生成同一角色的侧面角度图。
say.note: 传入参考图触发编辑模式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate a single photoreal or designed image via fal.ai using OpenAI's gpt-image-1 or gpt-image-2 model. Supports text-to-image and edit-from-reference workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to generate character anchors, scene keyframes, or storyboards that require precise layout and legible text.

say_en.text: Generate a 9:16 character anchor image with prompt: a young woman in blue shirt.
say_en.note: Uses default gpt-image-1 model for character portrait.

say_en.text: Use gpt-image-2 to generate a 1728x2304 storyboard with prompt: product showcase scene.
Generate a side angle of the same character based on this reference image.
say_en.note: Passes reference image to trigger edit mode.
